build: Existing LinuxRunner Release build 900 integration, ARM64 interpreter, JIT disabled
limits: Two pairs per desktop with reversed order; descriptive results, not a statistical significance claim or sustained reliability/performance soak.

All Arch runs began/ended nominal. All SteamOS runs began nominal; both socket runs and the second shared run ended fair; the first shared run ended nominal. Temperature was observed, not controlled throughout.
Compare modes within each desktop only: Arch software Xvfb/Core Graphics 960x540/default VNC; SteamOS Xorg virgl/Metal 1560x1112/adaptive VNC.
This is the fixed build measured in both modes. Historical pre-cleanup runs were not a matched before/after cleanup comparison.
Measures synthetic RFB enqueue to native-view handoff after presentPatch returns; GPU command submission, GPU completion, panel visibility and actual Magic Keyboard input are excluded.
Distinct numbered repaints are not desktop/game FPS. No CPU, battery or heat benefit inferred.
Arch keyboard pooled p95 slightly increased: socket75.551ms vs shared76.289ms; the per-run tail also varies.
Full app reset after each mode establishes starting conditions. Same-app crash-recovery evidence remains the separate cleanup qualification.
